canonicalRule: Canonical URLs must point to deployed production paths; remove noindex only after launch approval and final checks.
previewRule: GitHub Pages staging must retain noindex. Do not publish these drafts to repository root.
checks: Verify production domain DNS/HTTPS and ownership
Verify click-to-call 10:00–22:00 Asia/Tehran on actual phone
Verify 3-way navigation, forms and error-code lookup on phone
Check keyboard navigation and visible focus
Check image sizes, page speed and layout shift
Check title, descriptions, canonicals and sitemap response
Check robots.txt and sitemap.xml on final production host
Confirm no personal phone number exposure outside approved CTA behavior
